summary: First-person POV tour of a studio apartment in Murray Hill, checking out the bathroom, kitchen, closets, and living area with city views.

people.description: Young East Asian creator holding the camera phone, visible in bathroom mirror reflections, accompanied by a female real estate agent or friend in a black leather jacket.

quality.issues: Frequent rapid panning, motion blur, and quick exposure shifts when transitioning between rooms.

moments.action: Opening apartment door number 1106 and walking into the entryway, catching a quick glimpse of the layout and bathroom
Walking past the bathroom sink and looking into the mirror, revealing the creator filming in a black coat
Panning across the bright studio living space toward the large windows looking out at Manhattan brick buildings
